major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Wrath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use strictly on cooldown alongside your 1-minute burst tools for massive damage windows.

major_cooldowns.name: Execution Sentence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use as the opener to your 1-minute burst window to soak up subsequent damage.

major_cooldowns.name: Wake of Ashes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use immediately after Execution Sentence to generate Holy Power and deal massive AoE.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Toll
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use inside the Execution Sentence window to mass-apply Judgment.

defensives.name: Divine Shield
defensives.usage_rule: Use to immune all incoming damage and completely ignore lethal mechanics.

defensives.name: Shield of Vengeance
defensives.usage_rule: Use proactively to absorb damage and reflect it back to attackers.

defensives.name: Divine Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Use frequently on incoming moderate damage.

rules.action: Always sync Execution Sentence, Wake of Ashes, and Divine Toll together. Add Avenging Wrath to this combo every 2 minutes.
Spend Holy Power on Templar's Verdict or Divine Storm before hitting the maximum of 5.
Ensure the target has the Judgment debuff before casting high-damage Holy Power spenders.

source_summary: Retribution Paladin revolves around highly structured 1-minute and 2-minute burst windows. Between these windows, the goal is simply to build and spend Holy Power efficiently without overcapping.
